title: Port the recall skill onto Claude Code transcripts and bee state
action: Port the pstack recall skill. The source is at /tmp/claude-1000/-home-thanhsmind-Projects-goglbe-beehive/9d0933f3-e76c-498c-a471-1b5f7f684697/scratchpad/pstack-src/pstack/skills/recall/SKILL.md — read it in full first. Write .claude/skills/recall/SKILL.md. Apply the adaptation contract in the plan's Approach section. Two rewirings carry the cell. First, per D5, the transcript layout is different here: pstack reads ~/.cursor/projects/<slug>/agent-transcripts/<uuid>/<uuid>.jsonl, and Claude Code writes one flat file per session at ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<uuid>.jsonl, where <slug> is the workspace path with the leading slash dropped and every / turned into -. Verify that shape yourself before you write it: run `ls ~/.claude/projects/*/ | head` and quote what you see. Keep the ordering rule — order candidates by real modification time with `ls -t`, never by the uuid name — and keep the grep-then-read-only-matching-regions rule. Second, per D5, bee's own state is the cheapest and freshest part of the record and must be read BEFORE any transcript mining: add a step that runs `bee orient` for phase, blockers and next action, `bee decisions search --text "<topic>"` for what was decided, `bee cells list` for open and capped work, and reads docs/history/<feature>/CONTEXT.md when the topic names a feature. Say plainly that a fact already in bee state never needs to be reconstructed from a transcript. Third, per D3, the fan-out over transcript slices dispatches through the ONE bee door — .bee/bin/bee dispatch prepare with --runtime claude, --kind gather, --role extraction, a one-line --purpose and --json — then run exactly the tool and payload it returns; never name a model. Where the source hands the shared-record sweep to the why skill's source investigators, keep that handoff: the why skill lands in this same feature and its two sources are code archaeology and the bee store. Keep the output contract — capsule, threads with status tags, problems, next move — as it is. Keep disable-model-invocation true (per D6) and add the provenance line. Write to .claude/skills/ only (per D7).
verify: python3 -c "import sys;p='.claude/skills/recall/SKILL.md';s=open(p).read();sys.exit('missing frontmatter flag') if 'disable-model-invocation: true' not in s else (sys.exit('cursor path survived') if '.cursor' in s else 0)" && rg -q 'bee orient' .claude/skills/recall/SKILL.md && rg -q 'dispatch prepare' .claude/skills/recall/SKILL.md && ! rg -n 'cursor-team-kit|pstack/skills/|poteto-agent|generalPurpose|grok-4|claude-fable-5-1-thinking|subagent_type' .claude/skills/recall
